agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Our previous study found that statins can block the malignant progression of glioma mediated by EGFR pathway.

flag.reason: EGFR-high (IHC 3+) is an entry requirement and the record states statins block EGFR-pathway-mediated glioma progression, but atorvastatin is not a direct EGFR inhibitor; match decision drives the primary outcome.

coder_notes: Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but every patient receives the STUPP regimen, so listed as soc_backbone (agent_name_registered describes the regimen; not a registry intervention name). Treatment setting coded both: summary says 'primary and recurrent glioblastomas', yet the arm describes atorvastatin started 2 weeks after surgery on the Stupp protocol (suggesting newly diagnosed). Design is described as 'single-arm, double-blind', which is internally inconsistent. IDH-wildtype listed as eligibility (diagnostic; never candidate-matched).
